topics.label: Introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines the learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Concepts of cancer etiology, risk factors, and epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how genetic predispositions, endogenous mutation processes, environmental exposures, and geographic variations interact to determine cancer risk.

topics.label: Biological and chemical mechanisms of carcinogens and tumor promoters
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific infectious pathogens, chemical mutagens, radiation, and non-mutagenic promoters initiate or promote tumor formation in host tissues.

topics.label: Methods for detecting, testing, and evaluating carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the experimental, epidemiological, and genomic approaches used to identify carcinogens and appraise associated risks.

topics.label: Lecture summary and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer delivers concluding remarks and summarises the main takeaways of the lecture.
